blocky-bubbles.options.animations.toolti: Whether the bubble column textures should be animated (requires asset reload).
blocky-bubbles.options.biome_colors.tool: Whether bubble columns should tint with the biome's water colour.
blocky-bubbles.options.cullface_method.n: Bubble column faces cull when the adjacent block is anything other than air, including water, glass and other bubble columns. This matches the behaviour of vanilla Bedrock Edition.
blocky-bubbles.options.cullface_method.s: Bubble column faces cull when the adjacent block is either a bubble column or a full, solid, square side of an opaque block. This resembles how Java Edition handles face culling on most other blocks.
Compatibility with FrozenLib's WaterLikeBlock, allowing bubble columns to render inside e.g. mesogleas from Wilder Wild (requires asset reload).
blocky-bubbles.options.opaque_faces.tool: Whether bubble columns should render with completely opaque faces.
blocky-bubbles.options.quality.tooltip: Controls the quality of bubble columns.
blocky-bubbles.options.resource_pack_sty: The style of Bare Bones by @RobotPants.
